style: Original polished hand-painted 2D airline game sprites; warm white upper fuselage, cobalt blue belly and tail, restrained gold ribbons, crisp dark blue contours, soft cel shading, true transparent alpha, complete closed exterior, no text, logos, registrations, people, cutaway or background. Left-facing side elevation except airborne three-quarter title illustration. Preserve real prototype wings, engine type/count, tail and landing gear. Wide 1536x590 runtime canvas.
